title: MoM – G5 Gate Review – Project Bolt – 2026-02-10
content:
Meeting: G5 Gate Review – Project Bolt
Date: 10 February 2026
Chair: Rachel Kim
Attendees: Rachel Kim (PM/OCM), Marco Rossi (R&D), Sarah Chen (Procurement), Tom Walsh (Quality), James Turner (Supply Chain)

DECISIONS
- G5 gate passed for UK and DE markets
- France market G5 conditional — regulatory compliance documentation outstanding
- 3PL warehouse capacity confirmed for UK and DE launch volumes
- Single-source supplier risk for primary packaging component acknowledged — contingency supplier identification added as action

ACTIONS
- James Turner (Supply Chain): Confirm 3PL warehouse capacity for UK and DE launch volumes by 17 February 2026
- Tom Walsh (Quality): Submit G5 regulatory compliance documentation for France by 24 February 2026
- Sarah Chen (Procurement): Identify alternative secondary supplier for primary packaging component by 05 March 2026
- Carlos Mendez (Marketing): Finalise consumer launch campaign brief by 25 February 2026

RISKS RAISED
- Single-source supplier for primary packaging — no qualified backup, creating supply continuity risk
- France regulatory submission overdue risk — if not submitted by 24 Feb, G6 entry blocked for FR

NEXT STEPS
- Rachel to schedule launch readiness review for 18 February
- Supply chain risk register to be updated in ePPM
